_metadata.purpose: Byte-identical Debate transcript regression fixture (Stage 1 / topology-runtime).
_metadata.scope: Transcript only — Turn[] content/ordering/scoring. Logs, timestamps, and engine-internal counters are explicitly out of scope per the elaboration decision.
_metadata.captured_via: DeliberationEngine.run() with the deterministic stubs declared in byte-identical-debate.test.ts. Re-generate by setting REGENERATE_DEBATE_GOLDEN=1 when running vitest in packages/core.
normalization: round preserved (load-bearing — round-1-only Proposer, per-round Skeptic/Synthesizer)
_metadata.what_this_pins: DeliberationEngine.runTopology() with [topology].active = 'debate' MUST produce a Turn[] equal to this fixture (after the same timestamp normalization). The fixture is the regression contract for the Debate preset across the topology refactor. PAR-10: each turn additionally carries model_name (echo of model), neurotype_posture (posture or neurotype fallback), and convergence_delta (synth(R-1) - synth(R-2), 0 when not measurable). The legacy `model`, `neurotype`, and pre-PAR-10 fields are preserved unchanged.

topic: Should the team adopt feature flags for every new endpoint?

turns.content: Adopt feature flags universally because they decouple deploy from release.
Universal flags add operational tax; not every endpoint needs runtime gating.
Adopt flags for risky endpoints; let trivial CRUD ship without the overhead.
